questions_and_answers.question_text: What do yǒu guīju and méi guīju mean?
What is fúqi, and how does it differ from Western "luck"?
How is fúqi measured in practice?
How is a wife regarded in the traditional Chinese family?
Which Chinese word is closer to the Western idea of luck?
Write the Chinese for "That's the way we do things here."
In traditional China, what was reason to say a man had fúqi?
Write the Chinese for "The Zhāng family's grandmother is really blessed with good fortune."

answers.answer_text: Zhāng jiā nǎinai zhēn yǒu fúqi.

questions_and_answers.question_text: What does a husband's mother look for in a daughter-in-law?

answers.answer_text: A young woman who will obey and get along with her, and who will work hard for the family and around the house.

articles.text:
4. A: Zhāng jiāde érxífu hěn yǒu    The Zhāng family's daughter-in-law
      guīju.                        is a proper young woman.
   B: Shì a, Zhāng jiā nǎinai zhēn Yes, the Zhāng family's grandmother
      yǒu fúqi.                     is really blessed with good fortune.

Notes on No. 4

Zhāng jiā: "the Zhāng family." In Běijīng pronunciation, the jiā is unstressed and often neutral tone, like a suffix: Zhāngjia.

érxífu: "daughter-in-law." In Běijīng, often pronounced érxífur or érxífer.

guīju: A DEFINITE STANDARD, regulation, or custom which forms part of the conduct of a GROUP of people.

Zhào Zhōngguóde lǎo guīju, qǐng  It is an old Chinese custom that when
kède shíhou kèren yīnggāi xiān   you have guests, the guests should
kāishǐ chī.                      start eating first.
Zhè shi wǒmende guīju.           That's the way we do things here.
Zhème duō guīju!                 All this formality!

Yǒu guīju means "to have manners, to be proper (in behavior)." Méi guīju is "to be badly behaved," said, for example, of a child.

fúqi: This is a TRADITIONAL CHINESE CONCEPT: the DESTINY to enjoy happiness in life. It is DIFFERENT from the Western idea of luck (which is closer to Chinese yùnqi). Luck refers to CHANCE occurrences like winning a lottery, while fúqi refers to one's WHOLE LIFE SITUATION. Some people have more fúqi and some less. In practice, fúqi is measured by a person's wealth, prestige, and especially his or her FAMILY SITUATION. In traditional China, for a man to have a lot of sons was reason to say he had fúqi. In exchange 4, the grandmother is said to have fúqi because her daughter-in-law is a very proper woman.

Tā zhēn yǒu fúqi, búdàn yǒu      He is really blessed with good fortune.
yíge hǎo jiātíng, yòu yǒu yíge   Not only does he have a nice family,
hǎo gōngzuò.                     but a good job, too.

DAUGHTERS-IN-LAW: The relationship between the husband's wife and his mother is DIFFERENT in traditional China from in the West. A wife is considered to become a MEMBER OF HER HUSBAND'S FAMILY, so she is supposed to regard her mother-in-law as her NEW MOTHER, and show her the same filial obedience. The husband's mother, for her part, tries to find for her son a young woman who will obey and get along with her, who will work hard for the family and around the house.
